Tess (Marketing): planning a 50m webinar 'Inference Playbook: quick wins for latency & cost' — want punchy demos, clear CTA, and an office-hours follow-up. thoughts on run order and speaker splits?
Ethan (DevEx): propose 3x short demos (6-8m each): batching+cache, quantization impact, routing fallback. keep first live, second recorded, third live.
Lina (Speaker Ops): agree. need speaker confirmations + backups. recommend tech check + full run rehearsals.
Noah (Sales): audience routing: capture "ready for AE" flag and monthly token estimate. can we add "book a demo" CTA leading to calendar?
Tess (Marketing): run-of-show draft: 1) intro & goals (Tess) 3m 2) problem frame (Noah) 5m 3) demo A live (Ethan) 8m 4) demo B recorded (DevEx team) 7m 5) short panel (Prod & Cust) 7m 6) demo C live (Ethan) 8m 7) Q&A + office hours sign-up 10m 8) CTA & wrap 2m. leaves ~0-2m buffer. ok?
Ethan (DevEx): sounds tight but doable. will prepare fallback slides and a recorded backup for demo A in case infra hiccups.
Lina (Speaker Ops): rehearsals: Wed 9:00am tech check (20m), Fri 10:30am full run (50m). please RSVP. greenroom-bot will send invites + timezone conversions.
greenroom-bot: rehearsal invites queued. reply with ACK to confirm.
Noah (Sales): will draft the post-webinar AE outreach script (quick win highlights + booking link).
Tess (Marketing): landing page copy: emphasize concrete numbers (p95 latency, $/100k tokens) and three takeaways. Lina — how will we tag leads?
Lina (Speaker Ops): tags: demo_opt_in, ae_follow, tokens_bracket. mapping to CRM will be posted in #marketing-assets.
Ethan (DevEx): demo ops checklist: streaming enabled, ephemeral demo key, rate-limits, local recording. posting CLI snippets in run-of-show doc.
Tess (Marketing): yay. everyone please ACK rehearsals. also upload slides 24h before. :sparkles:
Ethan (DevEx): ACK both rehearsals.
Noah (Sales): ACK both.
Lina (Speaker Ops): ACKs noted; pushing run-of-show to #marketing-assets in 15m and adding backup slide pack.
